Shared healing reports one and subsequently clamps damage.
Explicit PSI Magnet hook calculates and bounds the healing contribution.

Finalization copies the total to x48. These facts describe recorded contributions, not a guarantee of exact fractional healing: shared healing clamps after reporting, and the Ness argument can undergo integer conversion.
